overview_description.description: Remedy is a pioneering online mental health platform designed to bridge the gap between patients and mental health clinics. Our mission is to foster a culture of wellness and mental health awareness in the workplace. With an intuitive interface, Remedy offers seamless access to a wide network of professional mental health services, ensuring employees can find the support they need, when they need it. We prioritize confidentiality and convenience, empowering individuals to take proactive steps towards their mental wellbeing. Our platform is more than just a service; it's a commitment to enhancing employee wellness, productivity, and overall workplace harmony. Remedy: Your Partner in Nurturing a Healthier, Happier Workforce.

product.name: Therapist and Clinic Matching Service
product.description: A platform feature that connects users with licensed therapists and clinics based on their mental health needs through a matching questionnaire and directory browsing.

product.name: Therapist and Clinic Network Enrollment
product.description: A service enabling therapists and clinics to join Remedy's network to offer mental health services to users through the platform.

product.name: Corporate Mental Health Support Program
product.description: A program that partners with companies to provide affordable, in-network mental health care and support for employees.
